notes.summary: Version 0.17.2 adds a new preview lint rule for unnecessary `re.compile` calls and improves `ty`'s type inference, protocol checking, and crash resistance across many edge cases. It also introduces return-type inference as an opt-in feature in `ty`.

features.description: New preview rule `unnecessary-regular-expression-compile` flags `re.compile(p).match(s)` and similar patterns where the compiled pattern is used only once.
`ty` can now infer return types for unannotated functions. The feature is opt-in via `analysis.return-type-inference = "always"` and also appears as inlay hints in editors and the playground.
`PLR2004` (`magic-value-comparison`) now supports a configurable allowlist of magic values via `pylint.allow_magic_values`.

fixes.description: `D417` no longer reports Sphinx-style escaped `\*args` and `\*\*kwargs` as undocumented parameters.
`PLE0643` (`potential-index-error`) no longer reports false positives when sequence literals contain starred elements.
`UP040`, `UP046`, `UP047`, and `RUF053` fixes no longer produce syntax errors for type variables with starred constraints.
`UP035`, `PLR5501`, and `PLW0120` fixes are now marked unsafe when they would delete comments.
`ty` now reports incompatible attributes inherited from multiple bases, even when the subclass does not override them.
`ty` reports all missing `@override` decorators together instead of one at a time.
`ty` no longer crashes or overflows the stack on recursive descriptor setters and recursive type aliases, including negated recursive aliases.
`ty` preserves runtime namespace fallback for partial stub packages, so modules missing from partial stubs resolve to the implementation.
`ty` now rejects applying `runtime_checkable` to non-protocol classes.
`ty` validates `TypeAliasType` keyword arguments and `Generic`/`Protocol` arguments directly, reporting invalid usage.
`ty` no longer widens or falsely reports errors for compatible generic return alternatives and union inference involving gradual types.
`ty` now allows subclasses to restore hashability and validates `__hash__` signatures.
`ty` preserves read types for dynamic attributes provided by `__getattr__` after assignment.
`ty` reports read-only TypedDict keys when deleting, popping, or defaulting them with clearer messages.
`ty` avoids inserting inlay hints for types that only exist in stubs.
`ty` now gives `Self` type variables distinct class identities, fixing synthesized method unions.
`ty` preserves `Self` when checking universal protocols and compares protocol receiver restrictions before binding.
`ty` infers ParamSpecs from call-wide constraints and infers intersections from correlated call specializations.
`ty` now generalizes nested types in inferred return types.
`ty` avoids cancelling requests for unrelated file changes in the language server.
`ty` reads uv's nested module ownership metadata in addition to the legacy field.
Prefilter bidirectional Unicode checks by UTF-8 leading bytes for faster scanning.
Improved documentation with corrected editor configuration precedence, user-level configuration discovery, and example guidance.

other.description: The `pyupgrade` rules `UP040` and `UP047` no longer incorrectly mention variance in their safety descriptions.
CI automation reports (ecosystem, memory, conformance, typing) are now published via GitHub Actions instead of `astral-sh-bot`.
Typeshed stubs were synced to the latest version.

notes.summary: Adds return type inference (opt-in) and an `unnecessary-regular-expression-compile` rule to ty, plus a new `pylint.allow_magic_values` option, with many typing precision fixes for protocols, generics, and recursive types.

features.description: Return type inference for unannotated functions, shown as inlay hints and opt-in via `analysis.return-type-inference = "always"`.
New `unnecessary-regular-expression-compile` rule (`RUF`) in preview, flagging `re.compile(...)` results used only at their call site.
New `pylint.allow_magic_values` setting to configure which values are allowed in `PLR2004` comparisons.
ty now reports incompatible attributes inherited from multiple bases (`invalid-attribute-override`).
ty rejects `runtime_checkable` applied to non-protocol classes.
ty validates `TypeAliasType` keyword arguments and recognizes `qualname` on Python 3.15+.
ty reports all missing `@override` decorators together, including on conditional method definitions.

fixes.description: `D417` now treats backslash-escaped `\*args` and `\*\*kwargs` as documented in Sphinx-style docstrings.
`PLE0643` no longer reports false positives when indexing sequences containing starred elements.
Fixes for `UP035`, `PLR5501`, and `PLW0120` that silently deleted comments are now marked unsafe.
`UP040`, `UP046`, `UP047`, and `RUF053` no longer produce syntax errors for type variables with starred constraints.
`UP040`/`UP047` descriptions no longer mention variance.
ty no longer crashes when negating recursive or dynamic type aliases.
Fixed stack overflows when checking recursive descriptor setters and recursive protocol members.
Fixed false `invalid-argument-type` errors when copying dictionaries with recursive callable value types.
Improved inference for constrained and ParamSpec type variables from call-wide constraints.
Improved protocol compatibility checks, including receiver restrictions and universal protocols.
Subclasses can now restore or disable hashing regardless of an ancestor's `__hash__` definition.
ty no longer narrows dynamic attributes after assignment when `__getattr__` provides them.
TypedDict operations on read-only keys now report the correct reason.
Inlay hints no longer suggest stub-only types such as `Unknown`.
Partial stub packages no longer hide runtime submodules.
Fixed incorrect tuple and generic inference involving nested types and generic returns.
Improved language server responsiveness by avoiding request cancellation for unrelated file changes and reducing pauses when clearing cached ASTs.
`ty` now supports uv's nested module ownership metadata.
